description: Docker is flatly incompatible with the kernel sandbox (docs/SANDBOX-FINDINGS.md), so this whole category already runs unsandboxed — these argv-level checks are the ONLY containment for what a `docker run` command line itself can request. A container's own runtime network egress, once started, is NOT visible to this or any other regex-level check; that residual gap is documented, not silently assumed away.
A -v/--volume/--mount flag whose source is / or a sensitive host directory hands the container the whole filesystem.
Container lifecycle commands other than the hard-denied dangerous flag combinations above.
Pushing images or logging into a registry is a network-egress + credential action — ask, not auto-allow.
